title: the old home
description: a minecraft horror mod inspired by the broken script and no_moon.jar
body:
an old entity from the start of cave game(minecraft) has been realised. now only you can stop it

a minecraft horror mod inspired by the broken script and no_moon.jar.it is currently in very early alpha. there will be three dimensions and around fourteen creatures. there is a new tree type and a new biome. new blocks, new advantsments and items have been added. the mod adds a boss fight with costume music, music discs, adds commands and will have jumpscares.v1.3.0 will be a full version with the finished boss fight three tructures, all three dimensions, every promosed creature, more blocks and items with a few advantsments
